description: This file implements JSON parsing and encoding functionalities, including lexing, parsing, and serialization of JSON objects and arrays, with support for nested structures and string escaping.

methods.name: json_obj_parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON object payload into a C structure based on a descriptor.

methods.name: json_arr_parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON array payload into a C structure based on a descriptor.

methods.name: json_obj_encode
methods.description: Encodes a C structure into a JSON object string based on a descriptor.

methods.name: json_arr_encode
methods.description: Encodes a C structure into a JSON array string based on a descriptor.

methods.name: json_calc_encoded_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the JSON encoding of a given C structure.

methods.name: json_calc_encoded_arr_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the JSON encoding of a given C array structure.
